name: anymorph
description: Connect an AI agent to your Anymorph workspace: read AI visibility, mentions, citations, prompts and pages as the dashboard shows them, export the data as CSV, and change prompts or pages where the workspace allows it.

interface.shortDescription: Your Anymorph workspace in your agent
interface.longDescription: Read your Anymorph workspace from your AI agent: AI visibility and mention rates by engine, the AI answers and the sources they cite, tracked prompts, competitors, pages and traffic, as the dashboard shows them. Export any of it as a CSV file for a report, and edit, publish or take down pages and prompts where a workspace admin allows changes from AI apps. Sign in with your Anymorph account and choose the workspaces and permissions to allow.
defaultPrompt: Summarize this month's AI visibility for my brand by engine
Which prompts are we losing to competitors, and to whom?
Export the last 30 days of AI answers and their sources as a CSV
